mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boards ( member_id, category, title, content ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.member_id, m.nickname AS writer_nickname, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM boards b LEFT JOIN members m ON m.id = b.member_id WHERE b.id = #{id}
